CustomField.description: ST-06, ST-12, S-16. The household a billing dispute belongs to. Case_BeforeSave_StampCustomerHousehold sets it on Billing Dispute cases only, so the Customer_Household sharing set shows customers their disputes and never Accord's default reviews. No one needs field access to it: the flow and the sharing set work without it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically on billing disputes. It's what lets the household see the dispute in the customer portal.
CustomField.label: Customer Household
